مَلِىْءٌ , (S, K,) also written and pronounced مَلِىٌّ, (Nh,) A rich, wealthy, opulent, man: (K:) or trusty, or honest: (S:) or trusty, or honest, and rich: (TA:) or a rich man, or one not literally rich, who is honest, and pays his debts well, without giving trouble to his creditor: (K, * TA:) or an able, rich, man: (Msb:) [a solvent man:] pl. مِلَآءٌ and أَمْلِئَآءُ and مُلَأ=ءُ. (K.) ―
-b2- Also مُلَأ=ءُ Chiefs: so called because rich in needful things. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
